# Model card: Behavioural segments of active clients

- Version `0.1.0+c4418043.20261018215130`, trained 2026-10-18, effort full.
- Data: synthetic data from the public generator (the numbers say nothing about any bank); fingerprint `c4418043910d`.
- MLflow run: kept in the local workspace's store, not published.

Intended use: Triage and prioritisation by people who review each case: a ranking of clients to look at first, never an automatic decision about a client.

## What it finds

Behavioural segments of active clients: Gaussian mixtures selected by BIC, checked against KMeans silhouettes, with stability measured by the adjusted Rand index over bootstrap refits.

Segments chosen: 6. Stability (mean ARI, 95% interval): 0.830 (0.696 to 0.982).

| Segment | Name | Clients | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | recent online use / recent branch use | 333 | 35.2% |
| 1 | high branch share / no card use | 147 | 15.5% |
| 2 | no card use / high online share | 86 | 9.1% |
| 3 | no branch use / low deposits per active month | 173 | 18.3% |
| 4 | no branch use / no online use | 79 | 8.4% |
| 5 | no online use / high card share | 128 | 13.5% |

## Training data

The public card describes a model trained on the synthetic generator's extract, read through the synthetic mapping into the same marts as the reference instance. On the machine that holds the extract the same code trains on the real marts in the private zone; that model, its card and its scores stay under `STRATA_PRIVATE_DIR`, and its metrics are not published.

## Ethical considerations

Segments summarise behaviour for analysis; membership is uncertain at their edges (see the stability above), so a segment must not become a label attached to a client outside analysis.

## Limitations

- One year of data: the outcome windows of consecutive cutoffs overlap, so a backtest's training labels share calendar weeks with its test labels, and seasonal effects cannot be told apart from trend.
- Code meanings marked `assumed` in the seeds (see `docs/data_card.md`) are used as stated.
- Synthetic results show that the pipeline works; they are not evidence about clients.

## Reproduce and refresh

`just dbt`, then `uv run strata train segments` (`--quick` for the effort of tests and demos; `uv run strata --private train segments` on the machine that holds the extract). The daily DAG retrains it, and its evaluation gate (`strata evaluate`) stops the run before the ledger if the model was trained on other data or ranks no better than chance.
